title: Three-SAT belongs to NP
statement: The language of binary strings whose decoded CNF formula has at most three literals per clause and is satisfiable belongs to NP: there are natural numbers $C,c$ and a language $V$ decidable in polynomial time such that, for every binary string $x$, membership is equivalent to the existence of a string $u$ with $|u|=C(|x|+1)^c$ and $xu\in V$.
replaced:
The language $\mathrm{3SAT}$ — binary strings whose decoded formula is a
satisfiable 3CNF — belongs to $\mathrm{NP}$, with the same certificate parameters
as $\mathrm{SAT}$: a satisfying assignment of exactly $|x| + 1$ bits, verified in
polynomial time after an additional width check. [AB09, Theorem~2.10, membership]
